name: Shenzhen Uniconn Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Uniconn Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, production, sale, and service of electrical connection components in China. It offers cell contact systems, high-voltage harness, low-voltage harness, and flexible printed circuit for new energy vehicles, energy storage systems, low-Attitude economy industrial equipment, medical equipment, consumer electronics, and other applications. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
